decision.explanation: Three distinct entities named 'National Indian Association' exist in the text: the UK-based organization founded by Mary Carpenter in 1870 (supported by docs d02, d03, d05), the Indian nationalist group formed on January 1, 1900 (supported by doc d01), and the US-based Indian Rights Association (often conflated in text) founded in 1879 (supported by doc d04). The fallible prior of 1873 is rejected due to lack of textual support and conflict with specific document evidence.
